title: Give the Queen a Square
setup: Your rook already sits on e6 with another on f3, and Black's bishop on e7 is the last piece holding the eighth rank.
hint: Look for the square where the defender must capture, not the square where it wants to.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd8+}} puts the queen where the bishop must come and take it — {{Bf8}} only loses faster. {{Bxd8}} empties e7, and {{Re8#}} runs down the file the bishop was blocking. The point is not the queen — it is the file it clears.
